title: Moises knows
text: Moises is an outstanding and professional tour guide. His knowledge of Barcelona both historical and contemporary made for an engaging tour. We have had food tours from Seattle to Tokyo and Moises is one of the best.
author: HomerJ17

title: A must do when in Barcelona
text: Moisés was an absolute gem! He was so impressive with his ability to remember everyone’s name and orders, bravo my man! We visited 4 different restaurant/bars which we would have never found on our own. I did not enjoy my first visit to Barcelona and for my second visit I decided to try this wine and tapas tour and wow Moisès blew me away with the wonderful and authentic Catalan and Spanish culture. I learned SO MUCH and left with a full belly and a fun buzz. My husband and I came here as our first excursion to a honeymoon launch and Moises really put us on a fun & yummy path for our trip. The

title: Highly Recommended Barcelona Cultural Tour
text:
Barcelona Cultural Walking Tour was absolutely outstanding. This tour was extremely informative, beautifully paced, and such a memorable way to experience the city. The tapas and drinks were delicious, and they added the perfect local flavor to the cultural and historical experience.

Alasdair was an exceptional guide. He was knowledgeable, engaging, thoughtful, and made the history of Barcelona come alive in a way that felt both meaningful and enjoyable. You can tell he truly cares about giving guests a rich and authentic experience.

author: K2235UWangelaw

title: Excellent Tour!
text: We had the good fortune to spend 3 hours with Moises learning about Barcelona’s food traditions, the city’s history, and tasting some of its best food and drink. He is a positive and engaging person who is a joy to be with. He includes everyone in the conversation and genuinely cares about his clients having a fantastic experience. Time in Barcelona was all too short, but this itinerary covers a lot and made the absolute most of the time. The restaurant in Santa Caterina market had an eggplant dish that I am still dreaming about!
author: F1318YAbarbarac

title: Fun & authentic experience!
text:
I highly recommend this tour, and our guide Moises. He gave us lots of history and local information, answered all our questions, and showed us some amazing food spots that we ended up going back to for full meals. He was fun and engaging and helped us see the authentic Barcelona. 
Every food and beverage we tried was delicious, and Moises did a great job of including our 10yo son even if the adults were sampling wine or vermouth. 
We thoroughly enjoyed our tour and our time with Moises in Barcelona! !Gracias!
author: A139YMbethw

title: 100% worth it!
text: 10/10 recommend! Moises and his team are so knowledgable and patient and offer great insight on local hot spots, as well as historical landmarks and sites. Great way to get to know the city.
author: R505SNmelissar

title: Food and Wine Tour
text: We loved our tour in Barcelona. Moises was knowledgeable and engaging. He brought great insight to our time together. I would highly recommend!
author: Benji C

title: Food and wine tour
text: It was a fabulous experience with Moises. He gave us great insights and showed a great understanding of food and drink from the area. I highly recommend!
author: Benjamin_C

title: Moises was a great guide...
text: Moises was a great guide and we were lucky to have him all to our family.  Lots of history and learned a lot.  Also great food and drink samples.  My husband really liked the vermouth!! Thank you!  It was great!
author: Kevin_M

title: Walking tour
text: Moisés was my tour guide. He was very interactive and very knowledgeable. He took us to great food spots. He also made sure we knew not to fall into some tourist traps on la rambla. I would definitely book with him again.
author: Teresa_S
